queue.userDirective: Generate a saga concept about a 'time patrol' or organization that must fix anachronisms in history created by time-traveling villains.
Ideate a saga that deconstructs the 'chosen one' trope, showing the political manipulation and immense psychological pressure placed on a young figurehead.
Ideate on character designs that draw from the 'body horror' of 'The Fly' or 'Akira' for a hero or villain whose powers are a grotesque, unstable mutation.
